user.title: Configure AUPU Q360
user.description: All values are validated locally. WSS is disabled by default and this step does not contact AUPU. The JWT persists across HA restarts but is never refreshed automatically.

confirm_wss.title: Confirm read-only connection check
confirm_wss.description: Submitting this page authorizes exactly one read-only terminal-info request. It does not send a device control command.

reauth_manual_token.title: Reauthenticate AUPU
reauth_manual_token.description: Enter a new valid Bearer JWT. The current token is never displayed.

reauth_method.title: Reauthenticate AUPU
reauth_method.description: Choose SMS recovery or a manual Token. Your current token is never displayed.

reauth_sms_send.title: Send verification code
reauth_sms_send.description: Submitting sends one SMS verification code. Sending is limited to once per 60 seconds, and the number is only saved when selected.

reauth_sms_code.title: Enter verification code
reauth_sms_code.description: Enter the six-digit SMS verification code. It expires locally after five minutes and is never saved.

error.invalid_signer: The signer JSON is incomplete or invalid.
error.invalid_device: The device identifier or tag is invalid.
error.cannot_connect: The connection or authentication request failed. No configuration was saved.
error.cannot_send_sms: The verification code could not be sent. No configuration was saved.
error.sms_rate_limited: A verification code was sent recently. Please wait before sending another.
error.sms_code_expired: The verification code has expired. Request a new code.

abort.invalid_state: The pending configuration is no longer available.

init.title: Update local credentials
init.description: Leave the token blank to keep the existing token. Changes are saved only after the complete candidate is valid.

data.raw_archive_enabled: Enable private raw discovery archive (off by default; uses only the administrator-mounted fixed container path)

confirm_wss.title: Confirm read-only connection check
confirm_wss.description: Submitting this page authorizes exactly one read-only terminal-info request. Existing settings remain unchanged if it fails.

error.invalid_phone: The phone number must contain exactly 11 ASCII digits.
error.cannot_connect: The read-only connection check failed. Existing settings were not changed.

abort.invalid_state: The pending update is no longer available.

start_discovery.name: Start read-only discovery
start_discovery.description: Starts reported-only Shadow discovery after every panel mode is manually confirmed off.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded AUPU Q360 config entry to observe.

all_modes_off_confirmed.name: All modes are off
all_modes_off_confirmed.description: Confirm that all seven panel modes are visibly off before the baseline snapshot.

begin_discovery_step.name: Begin discovery step
begin_discovery_step.description: Takes a before snapshot for one fixed experiment; the carrier and phase order come from the catalog.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded AUPU Q360 config entry to observe.

experiment.name: Experiment
experiment.description: The fixed mode, global level, AI temperature, or idle experiment.

round.name: Round
round.description: The first or second repetition of this experiment.

source_level.name: Original global level
source_level.description: Required only for the global fan-level experiment; manually restore this value before carrier shutdown.

target_level.name: Target global level
target_level.description: Required only for the global fan-level experiment and must differ from the original level.

source_temperature.name: Original AI temperature
source_temperature.description: Required only for the AI target-temperature experiment; manually restore this value before carrier shutdown.

target_temperature.name: Adjacent AI temperature
target_temperature.description: Required only for the AI target-temperature experiment and must be adjacent to the original value.

advance_discovery_step.name: Advance discovery step
advance_discovery_step.description: Takes one reported-only Shadow snapshot for the current catalog phase; no phase or device command is accepted.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded AUPU Q360 config entry to observe.

finish_discovery.name: Finish read-only discovery
finish_discovery.description: Validates and atomically saves the latest sanitized report.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded AUPU Q360 config entry to observe.

cancel_discovery.name: Cancel read-only discovery
cancel_discovery.description: Stops software collection without sending restoration commands; inspect the physical panel when prompted.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded AUPU Q360 config entry to observe.

discovery_wss_unavailable.message: The read-only state channel is unavailable. Stop collection and inspect the physical panel.

discovery_busy.message: A read-only discovery session is already active.

discovery_snapshot_timeout.message: The correlated Shadow snapshot timed out. Stop collection and inspect the physical panel.

discovery_invalid_transition.message: This action is not valid in the current discovery state.

discovery_step_expired.message: The active discovery stage expired. Stop collection and inspect the physical panel.

discovery_session_expired.message: The read-only discovery session expired. Stop collection and inspect the physical panel.

discovery_resource_limit.message: The active stage exceeded its sanitized change limit. Stop collection and inspect the physical panel.

discovery_report_save_failed.message: The sanitized report could not be saved.

discovery_raw_archive_unavailable.message: The fixed private raw archive mount is unavailable; no discovery request was sent.

discovery_raw_archive_failed.message: The private raw archive failed. Stop collection and inspect the physical panel.

discovery_raw_archive_limit.message: The private raw archive reached its fixed limit. Stop collection and inspect the physical panel.

discovery_invalid_parameter.message: The experiment parameters do not match the fixed catalog.

discovery_restore_required.message: Reported restoration is not confirmed. Restore the physical panel and advance the same stage again.

discovery_manual_restore_required.message: Collection stopped before restoration was confirmed. Inspect all modes, the original level, and the original temperature on the physical panel.

discovery_invalid_payload.message: The reported Shadow payload cannot be safely used for discovery.

discovery_ready_for_step.message: The baseline is ready for a controlled step.

discovery_prompt_mode_on.message: Turn on only the selected mode on the physical panel, then advance.

discovery_prompt_mode_restore.message: Turn the selected mode off on the physical panel, verify it is off, then advance.

discovery_prompt_carrier_on.message: Turn on the catalog carrier mode on the physical panel, then advance.

discovery_prompt_parameter_change.message: Change the tested level or temperature from the original value to the target value, then advance.

discovery_prompt_parameter_restore.message: Restore the original level or temperature on the physical panel, then advance.

discovery_prompt_carrier_off.message: Turn the carrier mode off on the physical panel, verify restoration, then advance.

discovery_prompt_idle_observation.message: Do not operate the panel during the idle observation, then advance.

discovery_cycle_recorded.message: The sanitized discovery cycle was recorded.

discovery_report_saved.message: The sanitized discovery report was saved.

discovery_cancelled.message: The active discovery session was cancelled without sending a device command.

jwt_expiring.title: AUPU token expires soon
jwt_expiring.description: The local AUPU token expires within 24 hours. Before expiry, use the integration Options to enter a new Token manually. This warning does not start an SMS reauthentication flow.

jwt_expired.title: AUPU token expired
jwt_expired.description: The local AUPU token has expired. Use SMS reauthentication or enter a manual Token before controlling the light.
